title: CSS Minifier

instructions.title: How to use CSS Minifier

steps.title: Paste your CSS code
steps.description: Copy and paste your CSS stylesheet into the input area. Accepts any valid CSS including CSS3, flexbox, grid, custom properties, animations, and vendor-prefixed rules.

steps.title: Choose mode: minify or beautify
steps.description: Select Minify to compress your CSS for production, or Beautify to format and indent minified or messy CSS for readability. Both modes fully preserve your CSS functionality.

steps.title: Configure optimization options
steps.description: Toggle advanced options: color value compression (#ffffff → #fff), vendor prefix removal, media query merging, selector deduplication, and rule merging for maximum file size reduction.

steps.title: Copy or download the result
steps.description: Copy the minified CSS to your clipboard with one click, or download it as a .css file ready to replace your existing stylesheet in production.

proTips: Always keep a copy of your original CSS before minifying — minified code is hard to edit
Use beautification mode to read and debug third-party or auto-generated CSS
Color compression alone saves 5-15% on stylesheets with many repeated color values
Test minified CSS across all target browsers before deploying to production
Minifying CSS is most impactful for large frameworks — small files save relatively little
Combine CSS minification with HTML and JS minification for maximum performance gains
troubleshooting: Broken layout after minification: Check for missing semicolons on the last property in rule blocks in your original CSS
Vendor prefixes removed incorrectly: Disable vendor prefix optimization if targeting older browsers
Special comments preserved (/*!...*/): This is intentional — these comments are marked as important and cannot be removed
Colors look different after compression: Hex compressions change format but not the actual visual color output
Large file is slow: For stylesheets over 500KB, paste in sections or use a build tool like postcss instead
